question: V. Satyanaravana Sarma was awarded with Padma Shri in 1970 for his contributions in the field of ________ dance.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kuchipudi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• V. Satyanarayana Sarma was a renowned performer and teacher of the Kuchipudi dance form.
 
• He was awarded the **Padma Shri in 1970** by the Government of India in recognition of his significant contributions to the field of Kuchipudi dance.
 
• **Kuchipudi **is a classical dance form originating from the Indian state of **Andhra Pradesh.**
 
• V. Satyanarayana Sarma was known for his distinct style, which emphasized grace and expressiveness.
 
• His work has greatly influenced the development and popularization of Kuchipudi dance both within India and internationally.
